format: Makefile or build script (used in OpenWrt build system)
description: This file defines a profile configuration for the OpenWrt build system, specifically for Broadcom BCM43xx WiFi devices using the mips74k architecture. It sets package variables and descriptions related to the profile.

methods.name: define
methods.description: Defines a profile for the build system with specific package sets and descriptions.

methods.name: $(eval)
methods.description: Evaluates and expands the profile within the build system's make process.

methods.name: $(call Profile,Broadcom-mips74k-b43)
methods.description: Invokes the defined profile to include it in the build configuration.
